description: Links evidence to a DRAFT dossier. Requires: dossier_create → dossierId, caseFileId. caseFileToLinkId is the case file holding the evidence (often caseFileId); call once per such case file. Every id in `ids` must be evidence of that case file (else 403; also 403 if you are not the dossier's owner or lack the editor role on the case file); already-linked ids are skipped. Certifying needs every linked evidence COMPLETED: dossier_evidence_list_to_link lists those. The API does not require the evidence group to be sealed, but sealing it first (evidence_seal) is advised. Then call dossier_certify. For one evidence group, dossier_group_certify creates and certifies in one call.

caseFileId.description: UUID of the case file that owns the dossier

caseFileToLinkId.description: UUID of the case file containing the evidences (often same as caseFileId)

dossierId.description: UUID of the DRAFT dossier to link evidences to

ids.description: UUIDs of the evidence items to link

name: dossier_evidence_link
